s.g: (pharmacology) A steroid medication that inhibits the action of progesterone, typically given orally in combination with misoprostol in early pregnancy to induce abortion.
(transitive, usually used in the passive) To offend slightly.
(informal) Somewhat indignant, irritated, angry, in a snit, put out or annoyed.

miffed.f: simple past and past participle of miff
